title: Canon claims file
description: Claims one chapter (or one canon area) cites. Each claim names a passage by text, book, adhyāya and verse, says in plain words what we rely on it for, and records who translated it and how far it has been checked. Rule 2: a caption, narration line or reveal may cite only an id listed here, and the id must resolve to verses that exist in the edition's verse index.

id.description: Text, book, adhyāya, verse: mbh.7.34.19. A whole adhyāya is mbh.7.33; a range is mbh.7.34.17-21.

edition.description: Id of the edition in content/canon/sources.json.

statement.description: What we rely on this passage for, in one sentence. Not a translation.

translation.description: An English translation of the passage, with who made it. Only for single verses or short ranges.

by.description: scholar-review: the scholar review of 3 Oct; draft: written in session, unreviewed; ganguli: K. M. Ganguli's public-domain translation.

status.description: etext: read from the e-text only; proofed: checked against the printed volume; signed: in a scholar sign-off record.

flags.description: Open questions on the claim (for example a verse number to confirm).
